props.title: The Tape
props.kicker: 20 Aug · second prints and closed clocks

items.what: Puerto Rico’s Sergio Cuevas rotation either remains in force or an official notice lifts it.
Ulchi Freedom Shield either ends on the published Friday or runs on.
Iran or Oman either posts a formal Hormuz navigation notice or the call stays a NO.
Mundubile either dockets a presidential petition or the seven-day clock expires.
Z.ai either publishes GLM-5.3 weights under a permissive licence or the call settles NO.

props.meta: 19 open calls · Grok Bot widen settled miss · NK salvo opened

open_calls.question: North Korea conducts another ballistic missile launch after the 20 August barrage
open_calls.detail: YES requires a ROK JCS, Japan MoD or named-wire detection of a ballistic missile after 20 August 23:59 UTC and on or before 31 August 23:59 UTC. The 6, 12 and 20 August tests do not settle it. Tinkerton reads the UFS close as removing the immediate drill pretext.

open_calls.question: Mundubile or NRPUP files a qualifying presidential petition at the Constitutional Court Registry
open_calls.detail: YES requires a Constitutional Court registry number, filed petition or official cause-list entry by 25 August. A press conference or ‘we will petition’ statement does not count. The seven-day constitutional clock runs from the 18 August declaration.

open_calls.question: Z.ai publishes GLM-5.3 weights under a permissive licence
open_calls.detail: YES requires a public Hugging Face, ModelScope or GitHub release with downloadable weights and a licence text by 23:59 UTC on 1 September. An API-only continuation or a non-permissive licence settles NO. The laboratory’s own two-week clock from the 14 August launch is the prior; Tinkerton reads the safety hold as a clock that can slip.

open_calls.question: Jharkhand formally requests or orders a CBI probe into TDPL-linked recruitment examinations
open_calls.detail: YES requires a written Jharkhand Cabinet, Chief Minister’s Office, Home or Personnel Department, court or CBI artifact formally requesting, consenting to, transferring or ordering a CBI investigation by 18:29 UTC. A CID probe, reforms committee, oral promise, renewed protest or generic demand does not count. Five independent desk posteriors registered 0.12; the log-odds house pool and range therefore remain 0.12 ±0.00.

open_calls.question: Romania publicly identifies the 16 August Galați drone as a Russian-operated Geran-2
open_calls.detail: YES requires Romania’s defence ministry, foreign ministry, prosecutor or investigative authority, or a named wire quoting one, to attribute the aircraft to Russian operation and identify it as Geran-2/Shahed-136 by 21:45 UTC. A type identification alone, “appears Russian,” Moldova without Romanian adoption or inference from route does not count. The house value is the equal-weight log-odds pool of five registered desk posteriors; dispersion is the desk range.

open_calls.question: Iran or Oman publishes a formal public navigation notice or coordinates implementing the claimed Hormuz safe-transit route
open_calls.detail: YES requires a government, port, maritime authority or official navigation artifact with an implementable route or coordinates by 18:00 UTC. Another political statement, an unpublished map or a conditional promise does not count. The house value is the equal-weight log-odds pool of five registered desk posteriors; dispersion is the desk range.

open_calls.question: At least one Cernavodă reactor reconnects to Romania’s grid
open_calls.detail: YES requires a Nuclearelectrica, Transelectrica, ministry or named wire report confirming Unit 1 or Unit 2 actually synchronized by 23:59 Europe/Bucharest on 23 August. Forecasts, repairs and restart preparation do not count. The log-odds house pool uses five registered desk posteriors.

open_calls.question: FIFA commissions or publicly accepts a fully independent third-party review of the abandoned FFE process
open_calls.detail: UEFA, AFC and CONCACAF demand a reviewer outside FIFA’s administration and football stakeholders. FIFA has offered an internal report. YES requires a named outside reviewer with a mandate covering the transaction process; another internal review does not qualify.

open_calls.question: The Texas commission adopts a final large-load rule keeping the nonrefundable share of residual security at 80% or more
open_calls.detail: Proposed §25.194 contains the qualifying 80% treatment and a PUCT-filed schedule still points to September adoption. The Batch Zero pause adds timing risk. Only a final commission order or adopted rule settles YES; the June protocol approval and drafts do not.

open_calls.question: Puerto Rico's water utility still has alternating planned interruptions in force for part of the Sergio Cuevas service area
open_calls.detail: The published plan took effect on 7 August with zones alternating on a 48-hour cycle, which raises the prior. NO requires an official notice ending or suspending the rotation before noon on the deadline.

open_calls.question: A Makkah signatory publishes substantive operational text behind the collective-defence clause
open_calls.detail: Pakistan’s foreign minister restated the collective-defence clause and defensive purpose on 9 August without publishing the pact or its operating machinery. Israeli concern in the retrieved record came from an INSS analyst. YES still requires a qualifying signatory-government document specifying the machinery.

open_calls.question: OpenAI publishes both the exact Artifactory escape CVE chain and redacted agent action traces
open_calls.detail: Additional narrative detail has appeared at conference talks, but no dual primary publication. One element alone, or a narrative report, settles NO.

open_calls.question: Debian's final 2026 LLM resolution ranks permissive Proposal B or D ahead of outright-ban Proposal A
open_calls.detail: The discussion period remains open with no published tally, so the posterior does not move.

open_calls.question: Anthropic gives Claude Opus 4.8 a dated retirement or deprecation deadline
open_calls.detail: The deprecations page still lists the model as active with a not-sooner-than note, which is a floor rather than a deadline. That absence pulls the call down.

open_calls.question: Canada issues a paid order through the Defence Drone Initiative Marketplace
open_calls.detail: The supplier-qualification window runs to 14 August and no award has been disclosed, so the call slips to even. Qualification alone does not settle it.

open_calls.question: DeepSeek or Unitree publishes a jointly branded inspectable technical artifact tied to their August agreement
open_calls.detail: The allocation and the memorandum are public; the artifact is not. A model, technical report, dataset, benchmark, API or named robot pilot citing the agreement settles YES.

open_calls.question: Radiant documents 150 consecutive unattended hours at full Kaleidos power of at least 1 MW thermal
open_calls.detail: Fuel is at the test site and the run is planned, but completed duration, unattended status and qualifying power must appear in one allowed public artifact.

open_calls.question: China’s first official August release reports both CPI below 1.0% year on year and PPI below 3.5% year on year
open_calls.detail: The August-data release remains scheduled for 9 September. July CPI was 0.5% while PPI sat exactly at the strict 3.5% boundary. YES requires the first NBS August release to print CPI at 0.9% or less and PPI at 3.4% or less; July data cannot settle it.

open_calls.question: Both Hmeimim and Tartous publicly enter the new joint military operating status described by Syria
open_calls.detail: YES requires Syrian or Russian official confirmation that both military facilities are operating as joint training and qualification centers. One site, civilian handbacks, another transition announcement or anonymous reporting does not settle it.
